name: mtm-gh-runner
description: GitHub Actions self-hosted runner launcher and image

scripts.lint: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings && node --check scripts/build.mjs
scripts.image: version=$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 | node -p 'JSON.parse(require("node:fs").readFileSync(0, "utf8")).packages[0].version'); docker build --platform linux/amd64 --build-arg VERSION="$version" --tag ghcr.io/codeh007/mtm-gh-runner:"$version" .
